Name: mowuzhu follower
Author: youngwon1
Description:
MoWuZhu Follower – Familiar Companion
Bring a little magical companion along on your Stardew Valley adventures!
This mod adds a cute MoWuZhu companion that follows the player around the valley. Once unlocked, your companion will stay by your side as you explore, farm, and travel.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
Custom Companion Sprite: Adds a custom pixel-art MoWuZhu companion.Follows the Player: The companion automatically follows you as you move around.Directional Positioning: The companion stays behind the player based on the direction they are facing.Smooth Following: Uses smooth movement to make following animations feel more natural.Map Transitions: The companion follows you when traveling between locations.Permanent Unlock: Once purchased, the companion is permanently unlocked for the current save file.[/list][heading]How to Obtain[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Visit the Traveling Cart.[/*]
[*]Purchase the Familiar Charm.[/*]
[*]The charm will be automatically consumed when added to your inventory.[/*]
[*]MoWuZhu will then join your adventure![/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
SMAPI
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
This mod adds a custom companion and does not replace the game's existing pets or NPCs.
[heading]Credits[/heading]
Custom MoWuZhu pixel-art sprites created for this mod.
Enjoy your adventures with MoWuZhu!
